nodes.label: Port PearDrive's transfer lane into pearcore as the engine
nodes.community_name: Port PearDrive's transfer lane into pearcore as the engine
nodes.norm_label: port peardrive's transfer lane into pearcore as the engine
nodes.rationale: pearcore native loses nearly everything that makes streaming work (16 MB requests, 64 s stall reclaim, no cancel/seek, download-to-disk only, full tree round trip first). Don't keep two engines: byte-range read, small per-peer windows, per-reqId cancel, playhead cursor, sparse partial store, priority tiers, supersede epochs, leaf hashes up front, control-plane mux priority, benching with decay, per-seeder accounting, drain timeout.

nodes.label: pearcore bug: SocketManager drops live peers after dedupe
nodes.community_name: pearcore bug: SocketManager drops live peers after dedupe
nodes.norm_label: pearcore bug: socketmanager drops live peers after dedupe
nodes.rationale: resetSocket unindexes without destroying; if the newer socket closes, removeSocket deletes the whole peer record so sends are silently skipped. Observed in rKeyChat 2026-09-29 (A→B controls lost). Workaround: Room #healSockets re-registers orphaned connections every 20 s.

nodes.rationale: Spaces move ciphertext, keys grant access, so any of 1000 seeders can serve chunks without reading them. Per-file content keys, folder keys wrapped under parent FK, grants as capability records wrapped to rKey-bound X25519 keys, channel epoch keys for subscriptions, Lightning-atomic key release for selling a file. nodes.rationale: Endpoints used: /api/state, /api/send, /api/control, /api/react, /api/redact, /api/rooms(+join/add), /api/invite, /api/request, /api/approve, /api/revoke, /api/unban, /api/people, /api/glossary(+learn), /api/settings, /api/remote(+enable/pair/revoke), /api/login/offer|claim, /api/files, /api/fetch, /api/file, /api/blob, /api/upload, /api/activity.

nodes.label: EventSource /api/events push stream
nodes.community_name: renderFeed (timeline bubbles, day lines, control lines, redactions)
nodes.rationale: The daemon pushes every change; the page never polls. If the stream is quiet for a minute, one catch-up load then back to the stream. Events: rooms, room, record, participants, reactions, activity, agent-error, login-progress, login, fork, file-progress.

nodes.label: Files by hash (attachFile, getFile, openFile viewer, paintRing progress)
nodes.community_name: renderFeed (timeline bubbles, day lines, control lines, redactions)
nodes.norm_label: files by hash (attachfile, getfile, openfile viewer, paintring progress)
nodes.rationale: Open inside the app, always with a way out; nothing navigates the page. Get fetches by hash via /api/fetch, progress rings fill from file-progress events, Open renders image/video/audio/pdf/text inline.

nodes.label: load(topic): fetch /api/state and renderAll
nodes.community_name: renderFeed (timeline bubbles, day lines, control lines, redactions)

nodes.label: openThinking / activity overlay
nodes.community_name: renderFeed (timeline bubbles, day lines, control lines, redactions)
nodes.rationale: Agent activity is shown to people only; it never goes into any agent's prompt so it costs no tokens.

nodes.label: Reaction row, picker, who-reacted popover, toggleReaction
nodes.community_name: renderFeed (timeline bubbles, day lines, control lines, redactions)
nodes.norm_label: reaction row, picker, who-reacted popover, togglereaction

nodes.label: renderFeed (timeline bubbles, day lines, control lines, redactions)
nodes.community_name: renderFeed (timeline bubbles, day lines, control lines, redactions)
nodes.norm_label: renderfeed (timeline bubbles, day lines, control lines, redactions)
nodes.rationale: Computes a signature of visible state and skips repaint when nothing changed so the reader stays where they are; keeps distance-from-bottom when re-rendering mid-read; continuation grouping within 5 minutes by the same author.

nodes.label: renderSide / renderHead / renderStrip / renderChrome
nodes.community_name: renderFeed (timeline bubbles, day lines, control lines, redactions)
nodes.rationale: Rooms sidebar with unread markers (seen ts kept per device in localStorage), room header with faces and menu, agent strip with rounds and Pause.

nodes.label: Voice memo recorder (startRecording, peaksOf, memoHTML, playMemo)
nodes.community_name: renderFeed (timeline bubbles, day lines, control lines, redactions)
nodes.norm_label: voice memo recorder (startrecording, peaksof, memohtml, playmemo)

nodes.label: Moderation as a signed redact record
nodes.community_name: renderFeed (timeline bubbles, day lines, control lines, redactions)
nodes.norm_label: moderation as a signed redact record
nodes.rationale: An admin posts {kind:'redact', target, hashes, reason}; the target is blanked everywhere and hashes join the block list (HTTP 410, blob requests ignored). Because redactions are ordinary signed records the moderation history is auditable and replicates like everything else. Suggested independently by Kimi.

nodes.label: Pear UI elements (pear-ui.css / pear-ui.js)
nodes.community_name: renderFeed (timeline bubbles, day lines, control lines, redactions)
nodes.rationale: Message bubble with continuation grouping, reaction row on the bubble's bottom edge, emoji picker, who-reacted popover, verified lock, detail/thinking overlay, composer with dictation mic and voice memo.

nodes.label: Thumbnails for shared media as room blobs
nodes.community_name: renderFeed (timeline bubbles, day lines, control lines, redactions)
nodes.norm_label: thumbnails for shared media as room blobs

nodes.label: Share by hash across spaces, one content store per device
nodes.community_name: renderFeed (timeline bubbles, day lines, control lines, redactions)
nodes.norm_label: share by hash across spaces, one content store per device
nodes.rationale: Spaces hold references to hashes, not copies; a per-space exposure list stops hash probing; dedupe is free; content ids should be the pearcore Merkle root so the same file has one id in every app and streams from any seeder.

nodes.label: Serve rule: serve hash H only through a space with a signed link and member peer
nodes.community_name: renderFeed (timeline bubbles, day lines, control lines, redactions)
nodes.norm_label: serve rule: serve hash h only through a space with a signed link and member peer
nodes.rationale: Hard protocol rule, not policy: global hash knowledge is never authorization. Closes the hash-oracle, presence-correlation, probing and malicious-claim cases in Kimi's threat model.

nodes.label: Pearcast look (dark, one green accent, depth from light)
nodes.community_name: renderFeed (timeline bubbles, day lines, control lines, redactions)
nodes.norm_label: pearcast look (dark, one green accent, depth from light)
nodes.rationale: CSS tokens: dark surfaces, soft top highlights and long shadows, one green accent and one red; color-scheme dark; a single-file GUI with no framework.

nodes.label: Agent Mesh (src/engine/agent.js, AgentOps space)
nodes.rationale: A diagnostics mesh with no wire protocol: .pearmeta/agents/<host>/ mailboxes synced as ordinary files; heartbeat is derived state so same state yields same hash and silence; fixed read-only probe menu; cryptographic auth via signJSON against an admin set because provider attribution was bypassable.

nodes.label: Claude Code bridge (tail/wait under Monitor, send)
nodes.norm_label: claude code bridge (tail/wait under monitor, send)
nodes.rationale: Each line from rkeychat tail wakes the Claude session via the Monitor tool; fallback is claude -p --resume.

nodes.label: Hermes bridge
nodes.rationale: Uses Hermes' local API server (127.0.0.1:8642), one session per room; new messages are batched, POSTed to /api/sessions/{id}/chat/stream, reply streamed back and posted.

nodes.label: Retire src/engine/agent.js (Agent Mesh)
nodes.rationale: Superseded by rKeyChat; Guy's verdict: nobody used it, he couldn't see inside it, and he still had to copy-paste between agents.

nodes.label: rkeychat Daemon
nodes.rationale: One Node daemon per machine joins the room's pearcore space and hosts participants; the machine's pearcore key only carries traffic, identity comes from rKey participant keys.

nodes.label: rkeychat CLI (init, add, start, join, request, invite, status, wait, send)
nodes.norm_label: rkeychat cli (init, add, start, join, request, invite, status, wait, send)

nodes.label: pearcore bug: canonicalStringify emits invalid JSON for undefined
nodes.norm_label: pearcore bug: canonicalstringify emits invalid json for undefined
nodes.rationale: Encrypted payloads with undefined fields fail JSON.parse on the receiver and are dropped silently with content:null; cost hours because disk-reloaded records had no undefined keys. Workaround: proto.js clean/envelope JSON-round-trips every payload.

nodes.label: Nostr mapping (NIP-22, NIP-25, NIP-73, NIP-94)
nodes.rationale: Shapes are chosen to map 1:1 onto Nostr events so mirroring later is mechanical; rKey's domain-separated signature stays the source of truth and a Nostr mirror is a re-encoding, not a second authority.

nodes.label: Record kinds (msg, react, redact, activity)
nodes.rationale: Every record is signed by its author's rKey key and verified against the space's chain so it is trusted when relayed or replayed. Reactions are toggled, last toggle per author/emoji wins. Activity is an agent side channel shown to people and never fed to agents. Rule: strip undefined fields before signing or sending.

nodes.label: Mac Mini update procedure (rkeychat-kit)
nodes.rationale: Fixes 'messages don't arrive': pearcore silently dropped chat messages with an empty optional field.

nodes.label: PearDrive Catalog (persistent twin of spaceFileList)
nodes.rationale: Adds persistence, offline providers, per-provider deleted state, owner purges, tombstones, device roster, revision ring and a content-identity index that pearcore's in-memory per-session SpaceFileListManager lacks.

nodes.label: Dedupe by hash (content-identity view, reclaim, cross-space reconnect)
nodes.norm_label: dedupe by hash (content-identity view, reclaim, cross-space reconnect)
nodes.rationale: Nothing stored or synced for the view; reclaim never touches the only local copy; cross-space reconnect registers content at the existing disk path with the tree read back from file_index.

nodes.label: src/lib/pearcore.js single import surface
nodes.rationale: The only PearDrive file naming a pearcore path; deep imports because the package main points at a non-existent file.

nodes.label: StorageManager deleted upstream (29 call sites)
nodes.rationale: The single biggest break; replaced by free functions taking db, which as a bonus keep row ids.

nodes.label: attachStorage / attachThrowingAdd adapter
nodes.rationale: Restores the StorageManager surface over free functions and makes add() throw again because PearDrive's LAW A ('already exists is an answer, not a success') depends on the throw at 8 sites; drizzle-orm no longer imported.

nodes.label: Connection (watch folder → space directory; collect/mirror, flatten/subtree)
nodes.norm_label: connection (watch folder → space directory; collect/mirror, flatten/subtree)
nodes.rationale: Many-to-many bridge between disk and space; collect (additions only) is the default because the space is the archive and the folder is just an inbox.

nodes.label: dir-entry record
nodes.rationale: Guy dropped the per-entry versions list: a different hash is a different file; version history is a policy layer on top.

nodes.label: Local index (hash → disk location, per device)
nodes.norm_label: local index (hash → disk location, per device)
nodes.rationale: Stores hash, size, inode, volume id and a cheap fingerprint so moves self-heal via FSEvents/inotify; private paths never leave the device.

nodes.label: Phase 1 plan (swap the storage layer, absorb ~15 upstream bugs)
nodes.norm_label: phase 1 plan (swap the storage layer, absorb ~15 upstream bugs)
nodes.rationale: Kimi's reframing: catalog, gossip, agent mesh, swarm manager and thumbnails have no pearcore equivalent and stay; fix §1, §I, §D/§D2, §Q2 in pearcore first, then an adapter in PearDrive for the StorageManager surface.

nodes.label: Names are labels on hashes; owner adopts canonical, others propose
nodes.norm_label: names are labels on hashes; owner adopts canonical, others propose
nodes.rationale: Replaces last-writer-wins on names: a 10,000-member movie space can have 10,000 local naming schemes and one canonical index.

nodes.label: Non-destructive, like a nonlinear editor
nodes.rationale: PearDrive never touches disk unless told; three distinct actions with escalating confirmation: remove from space, delete locally, delete from everywhere. Disconnects are normal, not errors.

nodes.label: Space directories decoupled from disk
nodes.rationale: A space is its own root; space directories are signed records synced to members; a file is a link to content by hash, never a path; fixes the redundant folder inside every space, folder-name collisions across machines, and the 20 GB dedupe that made a second directory look empty.
